name: Fakeface
title: fakeface.io
payoff: Swap faces in videos, photos & GIFs
shortDescription: Fakeface offers a seamless face-swapping experience for videos, photos, and GIFs. It supports various formats like MP4, JPEG, and PNG, catering to both casual users and professionals needing quick swaps in media files. Ideal for creating fun content or enhancing presentations with a personal touch, users can easily upload a face photo and swap it into their chosen media within seconds.
cons: Limited to first 5 seconds of videos
Only one face can be swapped at a time
